## About
Landmark Auto and Diesel Repair is a locally owned shop on N 7th Ave in Phoenix. We work on gas and light diesel cars, trucks, vans and SUVs, including Sprinter Vans, and we help drivers from Phoenix, Peoria, Glendale and the neighboring communities keep their vehicles running.
We keep the shop updated with modern diagnostic and repair tools, and we use quality parts and fluids. Our mechanics are happy to take the time to walk you through what your vehicle needs, from a routine oil change to engine, transmission and brake work.
At the first sign of trouble, or when scheduled maintenance comes due, give us a call to request an appointment.

## Services
- Diesel repair: Repair and maintenance for diesel vehicles.
- Preventative maintenance: Keeping up with your vehicle's maintenance schedule to head off bigger problems later.
- Diagnostics: We keep the shop updated with current diagnostic tools to find the cause of car trouble.
- Engine, transmission and brake repair: From complex engine and transmission work to brake jobs.
- Heating and AC repair: Repair for your vehicle's heating and air conditioning.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesel vans and trucks?
A: Yes. We service gas and light diesel cars, trucks, vans and SUVs, including Sprinter Vans.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. Saturday is by appointment only, and we are closed Sunday.

Q: Do you work with Snap Finance?
A: Yes. We have partnered with Snap Finance to make paying for unexpected repairs simpler.
